events.title: Aviation Enters the Jet Age
events.articleText: Jet propulsion moves from wartime prototype to commercial promise. Manufacturers now face a faster design frontier, and airlines begin planning for a new era of speed.

events.title: War Breaks Out in Korea
events.articleText: Fighting on the Korean peninsula sharply increases demand for tactical aircraft, transports, and rapid rearmament across allied procurement channels.

events.title: Armistice Ends Korean War
events.articleText: The Korean armistice cools urgent wartime demand. Procurement remains active, but emergency pressure eases and civil planning regains attention.

events.title: The Wide-Body Transport Concept
events.articleText: Design studies for larger twin-aisle transports gain momentum. Higher-capacity air travel and cargo operations begin to influence long-range fleet planning.

events.title: War Escalates in Vietnam
events.articleText: Escalation in Vietnam drives fresh demand for tactical aircraft, support fleets, and dependable military production capacity.

events.title: Expansion of Global Air Travel
events.articleText: Passenger volumes rise quickly as jet networks widen. Airlines push for larger fleets, smoother operations, and broader international coverage.

events.title: Global Oil Crisis
events.articleText: Fuel prices jump and airlines face sudden cost pressure. Efficiency becomes a board-level concern, pushing buyers toward lower burn designs.

events.title: Second Oil Crisis
events.articleText: A second fuel shock reinforces the industry shift toward economy, reliability, and careful route profitability.

events.title: Advanced Aerodynamics Research
events.articleText: Wind tunnel methods, cleaner structures, and better computational tools help manufacturers chase higher performance with lower drag.

events.title: End of the Cold War Era
events.articleText: Geopolitical tensions ease, changing long-term defense expectations and redirecting attention toward civil markets and commercial efficiency.

events.title: Digital Avionics Revolution
events.articleText: Glass cockpits, smarter systems, and digital integration begin reshaping aircraft capability, maintenance, and buyer expectations.

events.title: Global Aviation Crisis
events.articleText: Air travel demand drops sharply after a global shock. Airline caution rises, planning slows, and the market turns defensive.

events.title: Global Financial Crisis
events.articleText: Credit tightens, fleet renewal slows, and buyers delay major commitments while financial uncertainty spreads across global markets.

events.title: New Generation Efficient Aircraft
events.articleText: New airframes and engines set stronger expectations for efficiency, operating cost, and long-term environmental performance.
